title: Logout Timer
description: This mod allows you to set a timer in game and when the timer reaches your desired time it boots you from the world/server you were in. This is great for afking on large servers where you dont want to be found or just to not die in game.
body:
⏳ Session Timer

Take control of your playtime.

Ever find yourself saying "just five more minutes" and suddenly it's 3 AM? Session Timer is a simple, lightweight utility mod designed to help you manage your gaming sessions effectively. Set a time limit, track it with a clean HUD, and when time runs out, the mod automatically disconnects you from the world or server.

Whether you are trying to stay productive, managing screen time, or just doing a speedrun challenge, Session Timer keeps you on track.
✨ Key Features

    ⏱️ flexible Time Input: No math required. Type naturally like /timer set 1h 30m or /timer add 10m to adjust your session on the fly.

    🖥️ Visual HUD: A clean, unobtrusive timer in the top-left corner keeps you aware of your remaining time.

    🎛️ Easy Configuration Menu: Press K (default) to open a user-friendly menu. Start, stop, add time, or reset the timer with a single click.

    🧠 Smart Pausing:

        Singleplayer: The timer respects your pause menu. If you press ESC to take a break, the timer stops.

        Multiplayer: The timer keeps running even if you are in a menu, ensuring you don't lose track of real-world time.

    🔌 Auto-Disconnect: When the clock hits 00:00:00, you are instantly disconnected from the server or world. No overrides, no cheating!

🎮 How to Use
The Menu (Recommended)

Press K to open the Session Timer GUI.

    Input Box: Type a duration (e.g., 45m or 1h 15m) and click Add to set the timer.

    Quick Buttons: Use +1 Min or +10 Min for quick adjustments.

    Controls: Click Start to begin the countdown or Stop to pause it.

    Toggle HUD: Hide the on-screen timer if you want full immersion (the disconnect will still happen!).

Commands

Prefer using the chat? We have you covered:

    /timer set <time> - Set the timer (e.g., /timer set 20m).

    /timer add <time> - Add more time to the current clock.

    /timer start - Resume the countdown.

    /timer stop - Pause the countdown.

    /timer reset - Reset the clock to 0.

    /timer togglehud - Show or hide the overlay.

📥 Installation

    Download and install the Fabric Loader.

    Download the Fabric API mod.

    Drop SessionTimer.jar into your mods folder.

    Launch the game and press K to get started!
